description: This PHP source file defines the Scientific class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class provides functionality to create and manage scientific number formats for spreadsheet cells, including customization of decimal places and locale settings.

classes.name: Scientific
classes.description: A class that constructs scientific number formats for spreadsheets, supporting decimal precision and locale configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Scientific formatter with specified decimal places and optional locale.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the scientific format string considering locale settings (though locale has no effect here).

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates the scientific number format string based on decimal precision.
